name: allergen-matrix
title: Allergen matrix
description: Every dish against the fourteen EU allergens in a sticky-header table, with chips that hide dishes containing what you cannot eat.
docs: Pass dishes with a course and the ids of the allergens they contain and may contain. The columns are the fourteen EU allergens by default (EU_ALLERGENS, exported from the allergens file); pass allergens to use another list, each with an id, a full name and an optional short name for the narrow column head. A cell says Contains or May contain in words for screen readers and draws a solid disc or a ring, so colour is never the signal. The chips are a toggle group: value, defaultValue and onValueChange control which allergens are picked. Dishes that contain a picked allergen are hidden, and so are dishes that may contain it unless the reader switches that off (defaultHideMayContain starts it on). The count is announced as the list changes. The first column and the header row stay in place inside the scrolling table, and a soft shade on the right and bottom edge shows while there is more behind it; set --matrix-max-height (40rem by default) to change how tall it gets before it scrolls. legend, updated and note sit under the table. Pass labels to translate the fixed words.
